tools.name: find_brand
tools.description: Search ask10ais's published measurements (every public ranking and every scenario cell, asked in both Chinese and English) for a brand name. Returns its rank in each ranking and its mention rate with a 95% interval in each scenario, each with a link to the source page. Matching is a case-insensitive

tools.name: list_rankings
tools.description: List ask10ais's public ranking questions with their latest measurement date, panel size and top brands.

tools.name: get_ranking
tools.description: Latest measurement of one public ranking: each brand's rank and index score, merged spellings, panel size and completeness, plus a citation template.

tools.name: list_scenario_collections
tools.description: List published scenario collections: buying scenarios in one category, each asked with several phrasings and repeats in Chinese and English.

tools.name: get_scenario_mention_rates
tools.description: Mention rates with 95% Wilson intervals for one scenario in one language: which brands models mention, how often, and how many models mention them.

tools.name: verify_certificate
tools.description: Check an ask10ais certificate number (ASK10AIS-YYYY-NNNNNN): whether it exists, what it records, and whether it is valid or voided.
